opportunity: kuna decompile accepted a --option NAME VALUE pair whose VALUE the engine refuses, exited 0, and printed the default C byte-identically to a run with no --option at all, while decompile-all/functions/xrefs on the same pair exited 1 with `option <name>: <reason>`. Every ablation run through `kuna decompile` was therefore unfalsifiable: a mistyped value reads as `flipping this decision changed nothing`.
test_name: tests/cli/option-value-silently-ignored.json + tests/cli/option-value-accepted-still.json (make test-cli), plus 5 kuna-cli transcript unit tests
why_no_option_row: Nothing that can change emitted C moves. A run whose options the engine accepts produces the same bytes it produced before; a run that now fails produced C that did not reflect what was asked for. The refusal itself already existed inside the engine and on every in-process surface -- this only makes it observable on the subprocess surface. Gating it would mean shipping an option whose off position is `keep lying about the exit code`.
why_no_speed_block: No option to ablate, and nothing measurable to ablate it against: the change adds one extra pass over the same in-memory decomp_dbg transcript that check_errors already scans three times (a few KB) once per invocation, against a ~300 ms subprocess decompile. The interleaved min-of-15 below is reported only to show it is inside this box's noise.
root_cause: kuna decompile holds no error object -- it pipes a decomp_dbg script on stdin and recovers failures from the transcript (decompile.rs check_errors). IfcOption::execute DOES report the refusal as `Execution error: <reason>`, but errorisdone is forced only for a PUSHED script (kuna-console/src/interface.rs push_script_state), so a stdin script survives the raise and runs on to `print C`. check_errors had arms for load file / read symbols / load function, and none for option.
fix: option_failure(out) in kuna-cli/src/decompile.rs, modelled on read_symbols_failure: attribute a CONSOLE_DIAGNOSTICS-prefixed line to the `option ...` echo above it and answer `option <name>: <reason>`. Called from check_errors after the architecture arm (a dead image makes every option line answer `No load image present`) and before the analysis-commit arm (an option line runs first). The discovery-widening retry additionally requires option_failure(&combined).is_none(), because `option noreturn <not a function>` puts `Unknown function name:` in the transcript.

witness.before: rc=0, stdout = the full default C (byte-identical to the same command without --option)
witness.after: rc=1, stdout empty, stderr `error: option realtypes: Must specify toggle value, on/off`
witness.parity_target: kuna decompile-all <same> --addr 0x26a0 --option realtypes zzz -> rc=1, same stderr byte for byte
witness.unchanged: --option realtypes off -> rc=0 and the same C as before; --option togglerule "subright off" (two-parameter form) -> rc=0; an unknown NAME still exits 2 via optname.rs

prefix_coverage_sweep.tolerant_names_note: upstream's own lenient parsers print a success line; unchanged here and tolerated identically by decompile-all
